faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Common questions about the Cropto platform and crypto options trading

q1.question: What is Cropto?
q1.answer: Cropto is a cryptocurrency options trading platform that enables users to create, trade, and manage crypto options contracts (calls and puts). It uses an off-chain order book system with a matching engine to facilitate efficient trading.

q2.question: How do I create an option?

steps.2: Click the "Create Option" button in the header
steps.3: Fill in the option details (title, strike price, quantity, premium, buyer address)
steps.4: Submit the form - your option will be created with OPEN status

q3.question: What is the matching process?
q3.answer: The matching engine connects buyers and sellers for options contracts. When an option is in OPEN status, a broker can match it by providing a seller's Ethereum address. Once matched, the option status changes to FILLED and becomes exercisable.

q4.question: How does NFT minting work?
q4.answer: After an option is FILLED or EXERCISED, the option owner (issuer or buyer) can mint it as an ERC-721 NFT on the Polygon Amoy testnet. The NFT includes metadata about the option and can be viewed on PolygonScan. Each option can only be minted once.

q5.question: What are margin calls?
q5.answer: Margin calls occur when the collateral value of an option position falls below the required threshold. The system automatically monitors positions and issues margin calls when needed. Users can top up their collateral to meet the margin requirement or the position may be force-settled.

q6.question: What are the different user roles?

roles.farmer: Can create and trade options, exercise positions
roles.trader: Can trade options and participate in the marketplace
roles.broker: Admin role with access to matching, reconciliation, and index management

q7.question: Which blockchain does Cropto use?
q7.answer: Cropto uses the Polygon Amoy testnet for on-chain features. This includes:

features.1: CROPT ERC-20 token for platform currency
features.2: CroptOptionNFT ERC-721 contract for tokenizing options
features.3: All transactions can be viewed on PolygonScan

q8.question: How do I connect my wallet?
q8.answer: You can connect your wallet in two ways:

methods.metamask: MetaMask: Click "Connect Web3" and approve the connection in MetaMask
methods.manual: Manual: Enter your Ethereum address directly in the wallet input field

q8.note: Make sure you're on the Polygon Amoy testnet for on-chain features.

q9.question: How do I track my portfolio?
q9.answer: The Portfolio page shows your complete position overview including:

features.1: Total positions and P&L across all options
